# Folder-color setup waits for the intended account page before changing themes

The owned browser_folderTreeProperties setup waits for both a complete account-central document and a current URI containing the newly created account username before obtaining themes. The checked account-selection producer loads account central with the encoded server-root folder URI. Matching page identity matters because readiness alone could describe a different loaded document. The existing test helper then runs light and dark subtests in order; each theme change waits for windowlwthemeupdate and an animation frame. This is a scoped setup ordering change, not a production leak fix or a rule to add sleeps. The new wait adds no assertion or leak measurement. The inspected assertColor helper still lacks an assertion message, and cleanup is registered after the wait; these existing diagnostic and failure-path limits are not new patterns to copy. No test, leakcheck or theme UI ran.

Scope: mail/folder-tree/browser-test.
